descriptionChirho: The personal name Hushai, referring to Hushai the Archite, David's counselor and friend who played a key role in undermining Absalom's rebellion (2 Sam 15-17), and whose son Baana served as one of Solomon's officials (1 Kgs 4:16). All three clusters are grammatical variants of the same proper noun: bare nominative 'Hushai' (arb: حوشاي, kor: 후새가, swa: Hushai), a minor spelling variant (arb: حُوشَايَ, kor: 후샤이), and conjunction-prefixed 'and-Hushai' (spa: y-Husai, hin: और-हूशै, swa: na-Hushai). No semantic difference exists across these inflectional forms; they all denote the same individual.
